LHX.sentence: L3Harris slipped nearly 5% this week and, unusually, it's falling while its fellow defense contractors are rising — so this looks specific to L3Harris rather than a worry about defense spending, which remains steady.

ASML.sentence: ASML is quiet and ticking up a little — they're still the only company in the world that makes the machines needed to print the most advanced chips, so demand keeps flowing their way.

LIN.sentence: Linde is having a calm, slightly-down week, but the industrial gas business runs on long-term contracts and steady demand, so this is a business that just keeps humming along.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft dipped about 3% but has been a clear standout over the past month, with its cloud-and-AI business continuing to grind ahead without any drama.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher is roughly flat, but biotech funding is thawing, and since they sell the equipment those labs buy, better times for their customers tend to show up in their orders a few quarters later.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is steady — the pipeline toll-road income is attractive on its own, though not an obvious bargain compared to what safe bonds pay right now.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow is down again and now sits well below its highs, even though big companies and government agencies keep signing on for its workflow-automation and AI tools — the business hasn't changed as much as the price has.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore barely budged even as copper prices jumped, which sets up a possible catch-up given how much of its business is tied to mining and trading that metal.

RDDT.sentence: Reddit dropped hard again, but its advertising sales are still growing fast — the fear is that Google could send it fewer visitors, which is a worry about the future rather than what's happening now.

KOF.sentence: The big Latin American Coca-Cola bottler is quiet and looks inexpensive for such a dominant, steady business.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras ticked up with oil prices comfortably high, so its very large dividend is well-covered right now — the main wildcard is Brazilian government decisions about that payout.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the container-shipping giant, jumped 5% this week and is trading below the value of its own fleet of ships, though after such a strong run it's had a bit of a stretch.

MA.sentence: Mastercard drifted down slightly and is now oddly a touch cheaper than its rival Visa, even though people keep tapping their cards more than ever.

ISRG.sentence: The da Vinci surgical robot company slipped a little and has fallen more than its rival device-makers lately, even though hospitals keep doing more operations with its machines — and each surgery means more supplies sold.
